briefs.text: KHARTOUM — Drone strikes hit homes and a United Nations building in Sudan's capital.
ITURI, CONGO — WHO warns fighting is disrupting the Ebola response around a hospital.
BAYELSA, NIGERIA — Toll in the funeral-boat disaster reaches 24 as the search goes on.
GAZA — Strike on a food truck kills three; witnesses cite World Central Kitchen papers.
WEST BANK — Opposition leader Eisenkot calls settler attacks “Jewish terrorism”.
BRUSSELS — NATO holds emergency talks on Poland after Russian objects came down.
EURO AREA — Inflation rises to 4.0% in Eurostat's latest figures for the bloc.
MATHS — Debate rages over the Claude-assisted Riemann “proof”; Clay lists it open.
WELLINGTON — NZ hold India to a draw; Australia climb to second in the Test table.
BUENOS AIRES — Poland's president opens an Argentina–Chile tour in the capital.

hero.headline: COP31 ENDS WITHOUT A DEAL
hero.summary: The longest UN climate summit on record closed in Antalya with no overarching agreement, after the EU and climate-vulnerable states rejected a final text that never mentioned fossil fuels. UN chief António Guterres said he was “deeply disappointed”.

panels.headline: Ukraine sinks Russian corvette in Libya
panels.summary: Zelensky confirmed Monday that seven sea drones sank the Merkury, one of Russia's newest warships, in Benghazi harbour, and hit the weapons ship Angara.

panels.headline: Strike toll reaches 15 around Kyiv
panels.summary: Rescuers pulled a seven-year-old boy alive from Dymer rubble after 14 hours as the toll rose to 15: 11 in the collapsed block, three at a supermarket, one in Bila Tserkva.

panels.headline: Indonesia confirms 24 dead in factory fire
panels.summary: Officials confirmed 24 dead at the Fonusa Agung Mulia confectionery plant, with about 30 workers still missing as rescuers searched the unstable wreckage.

panels.headline: Nvidia brings back Huang; Wall Street roars
panels.summary: Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive; the shares leapt about 30% and the S&P 500 jumped 4.73% — its best day since April 2025 — ending a seven-session slide.

panels.headline: Democrats seal 258-seat House majority
panels.summary: A North Carolina recount flipped the final seat — Chuck Hubbard unseating Virginia Foxx — giving Democrats at least 258 seats, their largest majority since 1992.

panels.headline: Iran vows to fight the US naval blockade
panels.summary: After what Trump called Iran's heaviest missile-and-drone week in over a year, Tehran vowed to use “all available tools” against the US blockade; Qatar's PM went to Washington.

panels.headline: BepiColombo safe at Mercury after a glitch
panels.summary: ESA revealed its probe slipped into safe mode when Saturday's orbit burn ended early on a software glitch — but BepiColombo is stable at Mercury after an eight-year journey.

panels.headline: AI breast-screening trial opens to 700,000
panels.summary: The NHS EDITH trial is inviting nearly 700,000 women to test whether AI can spot breast cancers earlier and safely cut the human readers needed per mammogram.

panels.headline: India gives flood-hit Nepal a $1.62bn package
panels.summary: India announced a package worth 240 billion Nepalese rupees ($1.62 billion) for flood-hit Nepal, deepening New Delhi's support for its Himalayan neighbour.

panels.headline: Mexico captures “El Chapo Isidro”
panels.summary: Mexican forces captured Fausto Isidro Meza Flores — “El Chapo Isidro”, one of the FBI's ten most wanted — in the Sinaloa city of Guasave.

panels.headline: Alcaraz topples Zverev for ATP Finals title
panels.summary: Carlos Alcaraz powered past world number one Alexander Zverev 6-2, 7-6(7) in Turin to lift the ATP Finals trophy, a statement win over the top seed.
